propositions: Gate operations emit no progress signal to stdout/stderr during execution, causing supervisor watchdogs with 600s stall budgets to kill healthy long-running processes before completion

Local compute phases (material-assembly prologue ~27s, overlap-corpus retrieval ~40s) and model calls collectively exceed common 600s supervisor stall budgets while producing zero output at default log levels

Autonomous agents cannot distinguish hung gate processes from correct multi-minute runs due to output silence, resulting in incomplete state transitions and stranded epic/story closures requiring manual recovery
ADR 0089 and existing test suite explicitly encode silence-tolerance as correct behavior, classifying this as a feature-request rather than a defect

Periodic heartbeat emission via daemon thread or logging at gate operation entry points would provide liveness signals without violating async-deferred streaming requirements or total-runtime timer constraints
